{{Otheruses|Imperial officer}}
[[File:MoffJerjerrod-BaseSeries1.png|thumb|right|250px|Moff Tiaan Jerjerrod, Imperial Navy, dons an olive-drab Imperial officer's tunic.]]
[[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] wore the '''Imperial officer's tunic''' as part of their standard-issue [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|uniform]]. Depending on specialization, the Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officer's]] tunic varied in [[Color/Legends|color]], including olive-drab, black, and white. [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]] and her father/predecessor, [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]], wore a unique crimson-colored tunic.
